title: CB8-H: daily /holders snapshot (prospective) of 1,500 non-sports + 300 sports markets from the latest complete capture (binary, open, accepting orders, not weather or crypto Up/Down; market OI >= 1,000 from the Data API /oi at the day's frame time t_f), top-20 per token, wallets HMAC-hashed in memory
expected_value: prospective holder-concentration data for CH70 (windows 1 and 2)
data: latest complete capture + sidecar (base frame, touch, event OI) and the Data API /oi frame (OI at t_f)
public Data API /oi (about 4,550 requests a day, batches of 60)
next_action: q0163 processes each snapshot day once its markets are >= h + 30 h old; coordinator runs 'run_cb8.py holders-pin-h2 --start-utc <freeze commit + 2 h>' after the CB8 freeze; q0172 after T8_H1_end + 30 h
notes: H v5 (2026-10-17): PINS the v5 rules (H-v4/H-v5 amendments) (seals/cb8_holders_rules_v5.json, rules_sha256 5fe7f6b3ec1b971e138e3480d796e4c312066da06b133122e04220e316c157b6) and REQUIRES the v3 smoke PASS (q0160c) (creative_batch8/holders_smoke_v3.json, smoke version cb8-holders-smoke-v3, under that hash; a v1 result is refused). Depends on q0160c. Each day first builds the /oi frame: every base-frame market (about 273,000, about 4,550 requests of 60 condition ids, about 19 min at 4 rps via --oi-rps 4; /holders stays at 2 rps), resumable per batch (partial in the run directory, removed after the plan is written), t_f per batch stored in the plan, t_f asserted strictly before every /holders request. More than 2 % of base-frame markets in a missing state (oi_lookup_failed / oi_absent / oi_nonnumeric) ends the day: <date>.MISSED.json with kind oi_source (apart from kind stale_capture and no_snapshot); a frame build unfinished at UTC day end is also oi_source. A network outage exits 75 with the partial kept. Daily cost therefore about 19 min of /oi + about 15 min of /holders (1,800 markets at 2 rps): --budget-min 25 per chunk (resumable), timeout raised 2100 -> 2700 s, mem 500 -> 1000 MB (273k-market frame in memory, measured about 0.3 GB on a synthetic frame plus the sidecar). Stored market OI is OI at t_f (columns oi_tf, oi_t_f_epoch), not at the capture and not at h. CREATIVE_BATCH_8.md CB8-H Collection. IMPLEMENTED 2026-10-17 (cb8_holders.holders_snap), still a DRAFT until promoted. WHEN TO PROMOTE: after the q0160 PASS and a collector freeze check, ideally by 2026-10-21T04:00Z. The job records its first run in holders/deployment.json and refuses (exit 75, 30-min waits) until max(2026-10-21T06:00Z, first run + 2 h); T8_H1_start is the first complete capture at or after that time, pinned in snap/t8_h1_start.json with T8_H1_end = +21 d and T8_H_collect_max = +63 d. Promoting later only moves T8_H1_start later (first run + 2 h), it never backfills. QUEUE LIMIT: the worker marks a job failed after 48 consecutive exit-75 results (about 24 h). The job therefore returns a clean exit 0 (status idle_heartbeat) at least every 10 h while it waits (before the start, or between UTC days), which resets that count; exit 0 re-queues it at once and the next idle run exits 75 again. Daily rhythm: one snapshot per UTC day (plan with the seed arepo-cb8-holders-<date> written before the first request; one /holders request per market; 3 attempts then 'failed', counted apart from 'empty'); a day without a complete capture <= 2.5 h old is MISSED (marker, counted). Window 2 is pinned write-once by 'holders-pin-h2'; collection ends at min(T8_H_collect_max, T8_H2_end + 30 h) with status holders_collection_complete; a freeze slip is recorded, never extended. Disk: output cap 0.15 GB (reviewed cost amendment: about 1.9 MB a day for 63 days plus plans; the cap counts the whole run directory); a full cap is the declared sticky end state disk_budget (exit 4, never retried), H1-rep then 'not run (disk budget)'. Wallets: HMAC first 32 hex via cb8_common.load_wallet_key_strict (never creates a key; exit 2 on a missing or mode-unsafe key or a fingerprint mismatch vs wallet_key_fingerprint in seals/cb8_holders_rules.json); fingerprint in every manifest. Collection only; no analysis. Review amendments 2026-10-17: a plan still unfinished after UTC midnight is consolidated and marked <day>.INCOMPLETE.json (n_planned, n_done); idle waits for 'no complete capture <= 2.5 h old' and for data-dumps headroom return exit 0 idle_heartbeat (idle_kind no_fresh_capture / headroom) at least every 10 h instead of exhausting the 48-tempfail limit; holders-pin-h2 refuses a start earlier than the pin time + 2 h and records the pin time; --disk-cap-gb must equal the declared cap or the job exits 2. | 2026-10-17 15:35Z autopilot: data-dumps headroom guard 12.5 -> 40 GiB (ops only, not a declared argument): the user grew the host boot volume to 100 GB (root 89 GB, 60 GB free); collector cap 45 GiB, 4 GB free-disk guard unchanged.
